items.title: New EDRStartupHinder Tool blocks antivirus and EDR services at startup on Windows 11 25H2 Defender
items.description: Security researcher TwoSevenOneT, known for EDR evasion tools like EDR-Freeze and EDR-Redir, unveiled EDRStartupHinder this week. The tool blocks antivirus and EDR services at startup by redirecting critical System32 DLLs via Windows Bindlink, demonstrated on Windows Defender in Windows 11 25H2.​ Antivirus and EDR services operate like standard Windows services but with enhanced protection from…

items.title: Hackers Accessed University of Hawaii Cancer Center Patient Data; They Weren’t Immediately Notified
items.description: UH officials declined an interview request and have refused to provide key information, including which cancer research project had been affected or how much UH paid the hackers to regain access to files. The post Hackers Accessed University of Hawaii Cancer Center Patient Data; They Weren’t Immediately Notified appeared first on SecurityWeek.
